verdict: Leads are coming in, but cost per lead rose sharply this week.
narrative: Over the last 28 days, you received 127 leads at a cost of $10.94 per lead, all driven by Meta. This week, spend increased 60% while leads grew only 20%, pushing cost per lead up 33% — a sign that the campaign is reaching beyond its most efficient audience. The most recent three days show spend pulling back while leads held steady, which is an early sign the curve may stabilise. We're actively managing the Meta campaign scale to bring cost per lead back down, and we're watching lead-to-appointment conversion closely, as no appointments are currently being recorded against the leads coming in.

highlights.phrase: leads received in the last 28 days, entirely from Meta
average cost per lead this period, up 33% week over week
organic actions on your Google Business Profile this period, though activity dropped sharply in the most recent week

watch_item.issue: Spend is scaling faster than leads, inflating cost per lead week over week.
watch_item.fix: We're pulling back daily spend and adjusting audience targeting this week to restore efficiency before the end-of-August review.
